comments.schemaVersion: Format version of this settings document. Only 1 exists.
comments.settingsVersion: Label for this set of values. Change it every time the owner saves new settings so quotes can record which settings priced them. proposed-2026-10-12 carries the owner-approved numbers; the owner's confirmed Hub save releases them under a new label.
comments.mustSetBeforeCustomerUse: PLACEHOLDER GUARD. Every number in this file is a placeholder chosen from market research, not an owner decision. While this is true, settingsReadyForCustomers() is false and no customer-facing quote may use these settings. The owner sets it to false only after reviewing every value below.
comments.currency: All amounts are integer US cents.
comments.laborRateCents: PLACEHOLDER: $75.00 per technician-hour, charged per technician-minute. Catalog installMinutes are total technician minutes, so a 2-person item listed at 120 minutes bills 120 minutes (about 60 minutes on site). Chosen inside the observed Fort Collins handyman range of $50-$90/hr (HomeGuide/Thumbtack Fort Collins handyman snippet, 2026-09-27) and at the top of the $55-$75/hr garage-organizer range (Fixr/Angi snippet). Denver Handy Co. publishes $80/hr per person. The ~$29/hr Colorado handyman wage (Indeed) is EGC's cost, not a price.
comments.markupPct: PLACEHOLDER until the owner saves it in the Hub: 50% on every category, approved by the owner by email on 2026-10-12 (his +50% rule; was a 20% market-research placeholder). Percent added to the product cost (the catalog's retailPriceHighCents, or the actual cost entered on the quote). A category missing from byCategory uses default.
comments.minimumJobCents: PLACEHOLDER: $450 minimum per quote, matching today's walkthrough minimum in crew/gameplan.html recommend() (Math.max(450, ...)). Market references: Colorado handyman minimums $100-$200 for the first hour plus travel, Boulder-area 2-hour minimums of about $150-$300, and Denver Handy Co.'s $320 (2 people x 2 hours). Applied once to the whole quote with applyMinimum(), never to a single line.
comments.includeDisposal: PLACEHOLDER: when true, every item marked haulAwayApplicable adds disposalCentsPerItem per unit for breaking down and hauling away its packaging.
comments.disposalCentsPerItem: PLACEHOLDER: $10.00 per unit of packaging haul-away. The Larimer County landfill charges $22-$37 per pickup load in 2026 (larimer.gov fee schedule snippet) and local junk haulers' minimums run $60-$150; $10 per unit assumes several units' cardboard and foam share one load. No packaging-specific fee was published anywhere we could read.
comments.depositPct: PLACEHOLDER: 50% upfront for new catalog product quotes; the catalog quote builder calculates and saves the exact deposit from this setting. Existing signed walkthrough service quotes keep their separate 50% terms until that flow is explicitly revised.
comments.roundingRule: half_up_cent: each fractional cent rounds half up (0.5 cent becomes 1 cent), applied once per unit component (labor, markup), then multiplied by quantity for the line total. ceil_cent rounds any fraction up instead.
